label: L=9 copy step 12 (input orig(2), outputting orig(3)) on tokens p/j/3/k/u/t
explanation: Very sparse reset-gate unit (0.03% of steps), active only in the copy phase and almost only in length-9 sequences (98% of mass), at t=12 (90% of mass; a little at t=11 and 13), i.e. when the fed-back input is original token 2 and the model is outputting original token 3. Within that slot it prefers specific input tokens (p, j, 3, k, u, t carry ~95% of mass). Never fires in the original or delimiter phases or for L<=7. The position+token predicate captures ~85% of activation mass but has low precision (~9%): most L=9, t=12 steps with these tokens stay inactive, and adding prev_tok/next_out conditions trades recall for precision without a clean rule. Magnitude is not explained by the tested variables; the strongest firings occur for j/u/p/3 inputs at t=12.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=p (+4.40), phase=2 & in_tok=3 (+4.10), recall_idx=3 & in_tok=k (+3.35), phase=2 & in_tok=u (+2.57), recall_idx=3 & in_tok=j (+2.55), recall_idx=3 & in_tok=t (+2.43).
